name: Silent Takedown (Combat)
body:
You can take down lone enemies very effectively.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): When you deal sneak attack damage to a target who is unaware of you, while no allies are within 60 feet, you may make a Stealth check with a -10 penalty, opposed by your target’s Perception check. If your Stealth check is successful your target must make a Fortitude saving throw with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + the number of sneak attack dice you possess. If they fail they are knocked unconscious for one minute and creatures more than 60 feet away do not make Perception checks to notice the attack.
